messages:
Maya (CS): draft runbook for next-week go-live with KestrelCo — wanted to share a compact customer-facing checklist that focuses on prefill/prefetch, batching, and streaming fallbacks. PTAL, especially around the 'renewal risk' probes we should add.
Ollie (SRE): thanks — will skim. do we have recommended default values for small/medium/large tenants?
Maya (CS): proposing defaults in the doc: small: prefill=100 tokens, batch_size=8; medium: prefill=500 tokens, batch_size=16; large: prefill=2000 tokens, batch_size=32. These are conservative to avoid queueing. open to tuning.
Priya (Solutions): +1 on conservative defaults. also add guidance to enable short-lived warm pools (1-2 GPUs) for the first 72h for big customers. Helps demo phase and reduces cold-start noise.
Ben (CS Manager): love that. for renewal-risk customers we should add a 14-day telemetry cadence: daily prefills for first 7 days, every other day next 7. capture: avg latency, failed streams, prompt truncations, cost delta.
Maya (CS): adding that to the runbook. also a short script snippet to show customers how to prefill via the API:
```
# example prefill request
POST /v1/prefill
{
  "tenant_id": "kestrelco-prod",
  "prefill_tokens": 500,
  "ttl_seconds": 10800,
  "priority": "high"
}
```
Maya (CS): and an edge-case note: if they heavily rely on streaming and see partial responses, recommend enabling 'fallback_to_sync' for specific routes so UX doesn't degrade mid-session.
Ollie (SRE): technical nit: for batch_size > 16 on A100p3 variants we should enable adaptive-jitter to avoid synchronized load spikes. add config snippet?
Priya (Solutions): here's a minimal adaptive batch config we share with customers:
```
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 16
  adaptive: true
  jitter_ms: 50-250
cache: 
  enabled: true
  prefix_cache_ttl: 3600  # seconds
streaming: 
  fallback_to_sync: true
  max_chunk_delay_ms: 80
```
Maya (CS): perfect. I'll make a one-page customer handout: "Quick: Prefill, Batch, Stream — What to tweak pre-go-live". include the TTL table and the 14-day renewal-risk cadence.
Ben (CS Manager): also include an editable checklist they can paste into tickets: prefill applied, warm pool enabled, batching tuned, streaming fallback enabled, telemetry hooks installed.
redwood-oncall-bot: reminder: deploy scheduled for 2024-10-09 02:00 UTC — may affect warm-pool spin-up times.
Maya (CS): noted — will flag in the handout and advise customers to avoid heavy provisioning during deploy window.
Priya (Solutions): quick UX tip — if the app uses streaming to show tokens live, recommend debouncing frontend updates to 100ms to smooth jitter when switching from cached prefixes.
Ollie (SRE): LGTM. I'll add a short troubleshooting section: high tail latency -> verify batch_size vs. concurrency, check prefix_cache_hit_rate, check for model fallback events in logs.
Maya (CS): thanks everyone — I'll push the draft to the onboarding repo and ping product for verification. tagging @Priya for a final pass on the config examples. :thumbsup:
Priya (Solutions): will review tonight. :eyes:
Ben (CS Manager): great work. once final, we should send it to KestrelCo before the kickoff call.
Maya (CS): done — sending now. thread closed unless issues crop up.
